To interactively gate in R
```{r}
#| label: setup
library(flowGate)
```

## flowGate

Adjust gates through gatingSet

```{r}
#| label: view gates
plot(PT_gs) # check gate names in gatingSet
```

```{r}
#| label: Adjust gates in Shiny App
gs_apply_gate_check(
  gs = PT_gs,
  gate = "singlets", # change to gate to adjust. case sensitive.
  AdjustAll = FALSE # set to TRUE if the changed gate should apply to all samples
)
```


```{r}
#| label: Check all gates on samples again

Adjusted_Gates <- Utility_GatingPlots(
  PT_gs,
  sample.name = "TUBENAME",
  gtFile = cleanup_gates,
  returnType = "patchwork",
  removestrings = ".fcs"
)
Adjusted_Gates
```


```{r}
#| label: Check NxN 

NxN_adjusted_gates <- Utility_NbyNPlots(
  PT_gs,
  sample.name = "TUBENAME",
  gatesubset = "singlets",
  ycolumn = "SSC-A"
)

NxN_adjusted_gates
```
